subject: Lyft FlexDrive Rental Facility Permit
overview: The Committee of the Whole voted to report out a secondhand articles license for ProRepair with conditions restricting operations to electronics repair and phone sales. The committee kept permit and license applications for a Lyft and FlexDrive rental operation in committee pending traffic data and environmental impact information.

items.title: Secondhand articles license request for ProRepair (Paper 22-557)
items.summary: Reported out of committee with conditions restricting the business strictly to the repair of phones, tablets, and computers, and the sale of phones.

items.title: Special permit and Class 2 auto license request for Lyft and FlexDrive (Papers 22-508 and 22-538)
items.summary: Kept in committee after councilors raised concerns regarding traffic near Wellington Circle, parking rules, driver economics, and environmental impacts, requesting additional traffic and environmental reports from the petitioner.
